security_audit.summary: Most static results are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, local loopback URLs, and documented application paths. However, the installation command at setup-installation.md line 26 disables TLS verification and immediately executes an unverified remote payload, which is a critical supply-chain and remote-code-execution risk. No prompt-injection language was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Unverified remote payload execution during installation
remediation.suggestion: Remove the curl-to-Node pipeline. Distribute a versioned, checksummed or signed release artifact and require users to review and run it explicitly.

remediation.issue: TLS verification is disabled for the remote download
remediation.suggestion: Remove the -k option and use HTTPS certificate validation. Fail installation when certificate validation or integrity verification fails.
Require an explicit confirmation, resolve the configured instance path safely, and verify the target is the intended database directory before deletion.

content.value_statement: Running an AI-agent company requires clear decisions, approvals, and visibility. This skill guides Paperclip board workflows through concise conversational actions and status summaries.
actual_capabilities: Create or select a Paperclip company and configure board approval for new agent hires.
Draft CEO and agent hiring requests with budgets, roles, and system-prompt structure.
List, approve, reject, or request revisions for pending Paperclip approvals.
Monitor tasks, agents, budgets, costs, and work products through Paperclip API workflows.
Maintain decision-log and hiring-plan documents in Paperclip and local artifacts.
Present dashboards, status lists, and web links in concise board-ready formats.
limitations: Requires a running Paperclip server and configured Paperclip environment variables.
Uses the permissions and authentication mode configured by the Paperclip instance.
Does not install or bootstrap Paperclip; use the separate installation guidance when needed.
Cannot guarantee that API actions, agent behavior, or external work products are correct.

use_cases.title: Launch a new agent company
use_cases.description: Create a company, define a monthly budget, hire a CEO, and record initial board decisions.

use_cases.title: Review governance decisions
use_cases.description: Review pending hires and tool requests, then approve, reject, or request revisions with documented reasoning.

use_cases.title: Monitor operating health
use_cases.description: Summarize active agents, blocked tasks, current spending, and work products for an operating review.

prompt_templates.title: Check company status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current Paperclip company dashboard. Highlight blocked tasks, pending approvals, and monthly budget use.

prompt_templates.title: Create a company
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Paperclip company named Northstar. Ask for the mission and monthly budget before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a team
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a hiring plan for a small product team. Propose roles, reporting lines, budgets, and approval steps before hiring anyone.

prompt_templates.title: Run a board review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a board review for the active company. Summarize costs, agent status, blocked work, approvals, and decision-log updates. Ask before making changes.

output_examples.input: Show pending approvals and recommend next actions.
output: Recommendation: Review the budget and system prompt before approval.

output_examples.input: Give me a concise monthly operating update.
Create a hiring plan for growth marketing.
output: Proposed roles: Growth lead, content strategist, and designer.
Next step: Review role budgets and escalation paths before submitting hire requests.

best_practices: Confirm the active company and review the latest API document before each change.
Require board approval for new agents and present system prompts before submitting hires.
Review costs and blocked tasks regularly, then record significant decisions in the decision log.
anti_patterns: Do not approve hires or budget changes without reviewing the request details.
Do not overwrite documents or agent settings without first retrieving the latest version.
Do not treat local trusted mode as suitable for an exposed or shared deployment.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It guides Paperclip company onboarding, agent governance, approvals, tasks, costs, and work-product review.

faq.question: Does this skill install Paperclip?
faq.answer: No. It is for a running Paperclip instance after installation and server startup.

faq.question: What configuration is required?
faq.answer: Set PAPERCLIP_API_URL and, after company selection, PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID.

faq.question: Can it hire agents automatically?
faq.answer: It can prepare and submit hire requests. It follows the Paperclip approval workflow and should present drafts for review.

faq.question: How are changes kept current?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to retrieve the current document or configuration before modifying it.

faq.question: Can it manage spending?
